summary: Answer strict exact-RFI Question or Response requests from existing parser-scoped local evidence.
decision_refs: The active objective requires faster and more accurate file-grounded Q&A across RFI, Submittal and Email
The parser already creates exact RFI Question and Response evidence scopes
Reusing those scopes avoids an unnecessary model call without adding a second index
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements to the existing file-grounded question flow.
known_limitations: Only strict English Question or Response requests naming one exact RFI use the shortcut.
Multiple primary sources with the requested role fail closed instead of selecting one.
Quoted Email history, vision narration, more than 32 passages and more than 18,000 characters are excluded.
Interpretation, comparison, chronology and controlling-authority decisions remain on the ordinary grounded path.
